scope_zh: 本轮仅审固定已知A/005/015 seed0 M0基座上的两参数电荷条件核恢复合同。不能称恢复1288形状参数、均值/新时间机制、硬件响应或完整N01目标。

two_theta_known_kernel.formal_cache: one A/decoded/M0 pass over6593; actual A/B/Q fixed thereafter; no repeated A training/evaluation forwards

T1.Gram_conditioning_screen: scaled [Q/qref,(Q/qref)^2] on fit/test; eigenvalue ratio>=1e-4 permits secondary coefficient interpretation only
T1.identifiability_limit: A design Gram is a collinearity screen, not a proof that finite hard observations identify hardware parameters. Required synthetic functional/observed gates must actually pass.

T2.only_extra_mechanism: m=.9 centered Rademacher/Gaussian mixture in fixed first shape coefficient
T2.zero_or_unobservable_basis: untestable/inconclusive; do not switch component, mechanism, family or add trials
T2.not_learned: student remains Gaussian shape and two charge coefficients

proper_scoring_and_independence.score: full hard256 via fixed injective257 map; unbiased U-statistic self term excludes exact sample-index diagonal
proper_scoring_and_independence.paired: 512 IID parents; two teacher and two student draws conditionally independent; no single-target MSE
proper_scoring_and_independence.unpaired: two independent1024 IID parent/output samples; repeated parent index is retained as independent latent realization; no no-replacement batch shortcut
proper_scoring_and_independence.shared_prefixes: allowed across matched modes/teachers and initial/final comparisons; not across teacher/student roles in the score

parent_roles.split: deterministic original unique parent-ID SHA ordering, shared across all trials
parent_roles.IID_union_coverage: each required fit sampler stream must cover all5274 by2000G; missing => incomplete with no extra draw/step
parent_roles.not_REAL_or_full_pipeline_CV: Historical A/005/M0 bases are known; heldout means unseen to new synthetic target fitting. No original REAL/DEV waveform materialized.

support.parent_draw_population: Every original parent has32 original draw slots per bank,64 total per kernel/hypothesis. All slots and invalid/censor causes remain in raw output and denominators.
support.finite_definition: A feature is defined iff its computed scalar is finite under the unchanged observation/morphology rule. Q<=0/lowQ/guarded flags do not delete finite values. NaN/undefined values are not replaced by0.
support.per_parent_timing_and_coverage: A feature parent is supported only if that same parent meets all student/teacher bank and combined minima. nS=0 is an explicit reason, not a zero PIT or zero-error result.
support.per_parent_covariance: Common parent support must satisfy the feature minima for all9 features and joint minima for every45pair in BOTH teacher and student. The same complete-parent set is used for all81 aggregated entries and the matched teacher-split resolution screen.
support.original_group: Heldout all or one of3 fixed fit-Q strata BEFORE any valid-value restriction. Keep original parent count and original comparison-weight sum.
support.minimum_applies_to: Every required feature or complete covariance matrix, group and weightset; do not pool across strata, hypotheses or model seeds to manufacture support.
support.missingness: On ALL original group parents/draw slots, record finite/undefined/censor counts by cause separately for teacher/student, every feature and joint pair, each bank and combined. Weighted missing fraction = sum_i(w_i*invalid_slots_i)/(64*sum_i w_i), with the original group denominator; absolute teacher-student difference <=.01 for each required undefined/censor flag.
support.unsupported_output: Record parent IDs, feature/pair, nS/nT per bank and combined, missing causes, excluded weight mass, original/supported counts and ESS. Undefined per-parent metrics remain null with a reason. Retain their raw rows; no metric or parent silently disappears.
support.status: Support failure => pending/support_insufficient. Stage1 cannot open on pending. A supported but excessive discrepancy is failed only when its required resolution screen is also resolved.
support.waveform_exception: Full256 hard wave must be finite in every original slot. Nonfinite voltage is engineering FAILED, not a feature-support exclusion.

coverage.prediction: For each parent/feature use all finite values among that student64 draw vector; actual nS_finite may be48..64 when supported.
coverage.target: Only that parent defined teacher targets count in the coverage numerator and target denominator. Every undefined teacher original slot remains in its separate full64 missingness count.
coverage.randomized_PIT: For each defined teacher y, L=sum_{finite student}(S<y), E=sum_{finite student}(S==y); U is the independent predeclared uniform for this original target/feature/hypothesis. PIT=(L+U*(E+1))/(nS_finite+1).
coverage.missing: nS=0, nT=0, either bank<24finite or combined<48finite => unsupported parent/pending reason; never use65 as a substitute denominator, pad predictions or label undefined target uncovered.
coverage.per_parent: c_i,50=hits_[.25,.75]/nT_finite; c_i,90=hits_[.05,.95]/nT_finite. Save hit counts, nT_finite and nS_finite per original parent, bank valid counts and missing/censor reasons.
coverage.group: C_level=sum_i alpha_i*c_i,level on common supported parents. Do NOT pool hits across parents or implicitly weight a parent by its valid teacher draw count. Require abs(C50-.5)<=.04 and abs(C90-.9)<=.03, plus support and full-slot missingness-difference gates.
coverage.interpretation: Coverage conditional on a defined feature; undefined/censor probability is evaluated separately. ADC/discrete timing ties are handled by independent U, not deterministic inclusive intervals.
coverage.RNG_budget: Draw the already budgeted uniform for EVERY original teacher row/6feature/3hyp slot even if the feature is undefined; an unused slot does not add or remove RNG requests. Same uniforms may be reused for student initial/final comparisons, never for wave generation.

metric_formulas.primary_variance_curve_relative_RMS: sqrt(sum_i alpha_i*(vS_i-vT_i)^2 / sum_i alpha_i*vT_i^2). The denominator must be finite positive. This is relative RMS of the variance curve, not RMS of per-point relative errors.
metric_formulas.primary_variance_curve_max_relative: max_i abs(vS_i-vT_i)/vT_i on ALL original group parents; vT>0 required. No unsupported-parent deletion is allowed for this analytic charge-law gate.
metric_formulas.hard_wave_mean: sqrt(sum_i alpha_i*sum_t((meanS_i,t-meanT_i,t)^2) / sum_i alpha_i*sum_t(varT_i,t)); each mean/variance from the same parent64draws, variance ddof1; no between-parent scatter.
metric_formulas.hard_pooled_conditional_trace: abs(sum_i alpha_i*tr(CS_i) / sum_i alpha_i*tr(CT_i) -1). CS_i/CT_i are within-parent64draw waveform covariance traces from diagonal variances, not covariance of pooled parents.
metric_formulas.invalid_ratio_denominator: Zero/nonfinite teacher norm or variance denominator => pending/reference_undefined, never epsilon-adjusted or PASS.
metric_formulas.scalar_time_errors: For each timing feature on common support: d_i=meanS64_i-meanT64_i. Absolute aggregate error=abs(sum alpha_i*d_i); per-parent mean RMSE=sqrt(sum alpha_i*d_i^2).

covariance.sample_estimator: For each parent i and feature pair j,k, use only that parent jointly finite draws, pair-specific centered sample covariance with denominator n_joint-1. Keep n_joint and means for each pair; no covariance of all parents pooled together.
covariance.teacher_SD_scale: From finite teacher64 feature variance vT_i,j, d_i,j=max(sqrt(vT_i,j),fixed_floor_j). Floors are frozen before scientific inputs; record every active floor.
covariance.normalized_parent: Ctilde_M_i[j,k]=C_M_i[j,k]/(d_i,j*d_i,k), for M=student64 or teacher64; both sides use the SAME actual teacher scales.
covariance.group_aggregate: Cbar_M=sum_{i in complete_common_support} alpha_i*Ctilde_M_i. No outer product of parent mean differences is added.
covariance.group_discrepancy: Frob(Cbar_S-Cbar_T)/Frob(Cbar_T), with teacher Frob norm finite positive. Required<=.15 after support and empirical resolution pass.
covariance.per_parent_error: Also store Frob(Ctilde_S_i-Ctilde_T_i)/Frob(Ctilde_T_i) for each defined parent plus weighted summaries; null/reason otherwise. The .15 gate applies to group aggregate, not to every noisy parent.
covariance.teacher_split: Using the same common parent set/weights and teacher64 scale d: normalize each within-parent teacher bank32 covariance C_T0_i,C_T1_i, aggregate separately to Cbar_T0,Cbar_T1.
covariance.teacher_only_empirical_resolution: resolution_cov=Frob(Cbar_T0-Cbar_T1)/Frob(.5*(Cbar_T0+Cbar_T1)). The denominator must be finite positive. Require resolution_cov<=.075, exactly half the unchanged .15 gate.
covariance.unresolved: If teacher split support/reference fails or resolution_cov>.075, this covariance cell is pending/MC_unresolved independent of the student discrepancy; do not count it as expression failure or widen. No new banks/NN/RNG.
covariance.interpretation: The direct32-bank difference is a conservative empirical screen. It is not a theoretical64draw oracle error or confidence guarantee. Pairwise missing-data covariance may be non-PSD; do not clip eigenvalues or call it automatically PSD.

time.supported_parent: Same parent must meet the fixed actual finite counts in student and teacher, both32banks and combined64; all missing/censor causes retained on original64 slots.
time.student_comparison: Use combined finite student64 and teacher64 per-parent means with their actual defined-count denominators. abs(weighted mean d)<=1software_ns and sqrt(weighted mean d^2)<=2software_ns.
time.teacher_only_split: On the SAME support/weights define r_i=mean(Tbank0 finite draws)-mean(Tbank1 finite draws). Resolution aggregate=abs(sum alpha*r); resolution_RMSE=sqrt(sum alpha*r^2).
time.unresolved: If either teacher-only split resolution exceeds half of its unchanged1ns/2ns student gate, or finite support fails, pending/MC_unresolved; do not call student expression failure. Missing/censor fraction gate remains separate.
time.empirical_reference_only: Reuse existing teacher32+32. No extra timing mechanism, fitted floor, sample bank, random number or observation is introduced.

conditional_moments_and_MC.limits: Teacher32 split screens are conservative empirical resolution checks; they are not theoretical64-draw oracle errors or confidence guarantees. MC unresolved => pending/closed stage2, not expression failure.

weights.members: Original heldout all group plus3 strata using fit-parent actualA-Q tertiles with fixed NumPy linear quantile rule; group membership frozen before targets. Parents remain in exactly one stratum and in allheldout.
weights.raw_weights: nominal w_i=1; low/high use the existing globally ranked heldout-Q exp(-/+log2*u_i) weights. Do not rerank within a stratum or renormalize original physical weights.
weights.original_denominator: For each original group G, W_G=sum_{i in G}w_i and N_G=|G|. Supported set I is metric-specific only as allowed above.
weights.normalized_weights: alpha_i=w_i/sum_{j in I}w_j for i in common support I; sum(alpha)=1. Record W_I/W_G and |I|/N_G.
weights.ESS: ESS=1/sum_i(alpha_i^2)=(sum_i w_i)^2/sum_i(w_i^2); require ESS>=.5*N_G and the other fixed support minima.
weights.same_parent_difference_SE: For a parent-vector d_i, mu=sum alpha_i*d_i and SE_HC1=sqrt(N_I/(N_I-1)*sum_i alpha_i^2*(d_i-mu)^2). N_I>=64. This reduces exactly to sampleSD/sqrt(N) at equal weights.
weights.scope: A prespecified descriptive parent-cluster dispersion estimate, pointwise per fixed cell on this finite synthetic cohort; not an exact64draw MC oracle, familywise confidence guarantee, model-retrain uncertainty or hardware interval.
weights.non_scalar_metrics: Ratios/RMSE/Frobenius below use the same alpha and explicit fixed formulas; do not average per-parent ratios unless explicitly named.

energy.bank_formula: For parent i,h,bank b use m=n=32 independent student/teacher hard waves in fixed257metric: e_i,b=mean_{r,l}d(S_i,b,r,T_i,b,l)-sum_{r!=s}d(S_i,b,r,S_i,b,s)/(2*32*31). Self diagonal excluded; no teacher-student latent or noise sharing.
energy.mean_two_banks: e_i^M=.5*(e_i,0^M+e_i,1^M), M=initial or final. No pooled64 energy distance substitution.
energy.teacher_reference: r_i=.5*(ES_U(Tbank0 forecast,Tbank1 targets)+ES_U(Tbank1 forecast,Tbank0 targets)), each m=n=32 and self denominator32*31. Independent opposite teacher banks; cross distance matrix may be transposed/reused for the reverse direction.
energy.improvement_difference: d_i=e_i^final-e_i^initial on the SAME original parent, hypothesis, score-bank and common random student initial/final library. Teacher library independent of every student.
energy.upper95: U95=mu_w(d)+1.959963984540054*SE_HC1(d), fixed z before data. Require U95<0; signed means/SE/upper retained. No loss positivity gate or clamp.
energy.excess_reference: z_i=e_i^final-r_i, using matched parent i. Compute mu_w(z) and SE_HC1(z) directly. Require mu_w(z)<=max(.02*abs(mu_w(r)),3*SE_HC1(z)). Do not add separate independent SEs of final/reference.
energy.support: All32 waves per score bank must be finite. Parent/group support and ESS use original group membership; no scalar-feature missingness exclusion affects energy.
energy.teacher_T1_T2_optional_descriptive_contr: If reporting conditional T1-vs-T2 energy distance, compare T1bank0 withT2bank1 and T1bank1 withT2bank0 using unbiased cross/self terms. Corresponding same-bank Gaussian prefixes are coupled and may NOT be treated as independent cross samples. This contrast is descriptive only, no additional gate/forward/AD/RNG.
energy.signed_values: Unbiased teacher-self-adjusted/energy-distance estimates may be negative; preserve them exactly.
energy.inference_scope: Pointwise descriptive parent-cluster bound on fixed synthetic parents and random libraries, not a simultaneous95% guarantee across the gate matrix.

parent_weight_and_energy.original_physical_weights: preserve verbatim if available; otherwise unknown. Synthetic count/comparison weights remain separate.

required_rows.applies_to: Every required feature/pair/matrix cell; counts on original group

matrix.stage1_gate: PASS only if every required cell for BOTH seeds is resolved and passes. Any pending or failed cell closes stage2; save all reasons. A pending MC screen is not relabelled expression failure.
matrix.remaining_trials: Same matrix reported for each later trial, with no additional model selection, retry or family. T2 failure or observed indistinguishability is a result, not authorization for an extension.
matrix.multiple_cells: Shared parents/noise prefixes/weights are correlated; do not multiply the apparent sample size or call these simultaneous95% tests.

caps.distance_matrix: Stream64 rows against1024 rows, mask self sample-index diagonals explicitly; no P6593 xR64 xR64 x256 resident tensor.
caps.rollout: Only owned N01 tree. Native supervisor caps RSS/VM as supported/GPU/output/wall, original exclusive lock, durable entered/completed, atomic CP and FAILED retained. First update plus same-snapshot current PID/boot/startticks/parent/cmd/cwd/resource health or full native0 terminal, then one future wake and rest.
caps.preflight: Actual host idle GPU/CPU/RAM/disk checked only on later explicit native authorization, not queried for this proposal.
caps.cached_tensors_release: Release decoded immediately after each fixed head chunk; mmap A/B/Q read-only, transfer needed parent chunk only, release eval rawbank after archive/moments. No arbitrary cache of REAL or old016 incomplete features.

remote_payloads.report: Scalar features/finite9x9moments and waveform mean/diagonal variance only. No duplicate float64 waveform in REPORT, no dense256cov. Full hard code256 + original baseline100 permit savedADC roundtrip.
remote_payloads.charge: Per-draw actual q/mu/v, parent/draw IDs and fixed A/B cache digest, no broadcast to substitute actual values. Actual A is one formal fixed cache value per parent; no repeatedA NN calls.
remote_payloads.teacher_latent_storage: RNG state and exact requested shapes/digests; teacher latent not deployment input or same-latent acceptance evidence.
remote_payloads.raw_files: Retain remote, select small JSON/CSV/logs/thin checkpoints only; later saved-array audit if registered once, never silently rerun scientific forward.
remote_payloads.remote_arrays: Complete per-parent native32 and derived64 waveform means/diagonal variances, cov9 matrices, every feature/pair valid count, timing/coverage denominators and support reasons remain as remote arrays with SHA/inventory. Parent error arrays remain remote; selected JSON is an aggregate view, not a replacement.
remote_payloads.selected_small_package: <=256MiB including controls/logs: all aggregate gate cells, original/finite support denominators, missing/censor summaries, weights/ESS, split/index and raw-array SHA inventory plus necessary small2theta checkpoints. Do not try to select full per-parent waveform/cov arrays.
remote_payloads.cap_failure: 17GiB total and per-trial/shared caps are hard. If output or selected-package cap would be exceeded, preserve partial evidence and fail; do not silently delete a required metric, parent, gate or denominator to fit the cap.

resources_storage_and_stop.scope: Resource availability not queried here. Later explicit native preflight and enforceable guards are required; planned bounds are not measured guarantees.
resources_storage_and_stop.small_collection: <=256MiB aggregate gate cells, full original/finite denominators, ESS/weights/index/raw SHA inventory and thin2theta checkpoints; complete per-parent arrays remain remote.
resources_storage_and_stop.cap_exceeded: preserve partial and fail; never delete required metrics/parents/denominators
resources_storage_and_stop.first_proof: both theta finite nonzero gradients and actual update plus same-snapshot current identity/resources/durable chain, or fully validated native0 terminal; then one wake/rest

resolved_one_round_clarifications.resolution: actual nS_finite+1, defined teacher targets,24 per bank/48 total; original support/mass95%,>=64parents, ESS>=originalN/2; pending otherwise

resolved_one_round_clarifications.resolution: within-parent pairwise covariance, same teacher64 scales/floors, common-support weighted group aggregate then Frob; no between-parent scatter; teacher32 split .075 screen
teacher split .5ns aggregate/1ns parentRMSE screen before original1ns/2ns discrepancy gates; unresolved pending

resolved_one_round_clarifications.issue: parent vs draw weighting, RMS/trace/energy SE
resolved_one_round_clarifications.resolution: explicit variance-curve norm ratio, pooled conditional trace, per-parent coverage then parent weighting, matched-parent weighted HC1 and fixedz1.959963984540054
2theta kept invariant, whole-job one failureCP remains available after successful stage1; additive counters alone differ

resolved_one_round_clarifications.resolution: computed cross/self including masked diagonals explicitly counted; eval distance arithmetic bounded; full per-parent arrays remote, small aggregate selection cap enforced

whole_job_nonadditive_allowances.rule: At most one failure checkpoint over the whole job. Stage1 success consumes none; stage2 still has one available. Do not difference1-1 into0 or reset the allowance per phase.

budget_independent_reconciliation.normal_request_unit: requested tensor scalar outputs, not internal PRNG words

checks.name: zero_student_PIT_requires_pending_despite_uniform_formula
checks.meaning: n=0 produces U algebraically, so support cannot be accepted from this formula alone

next_authorized_boundary_zh: 合同可交root作一次实施决定。此回执不授权注册、真实数据/CP访问或native启动；实现后按既定source/code独审，再由root明确授权并登记唯一受控执行。不得新增候选、第三随机库或为失败改门。
conclusion_zh: 本轮集中问题均已解决，017两参数已知核教师合同通过独审。先做T1配对两seed，只有全部预定组/权重/假设的必需统计resolved且PASS才进入余下六次；任何pending/失败均按合同停止并保留证据。教师控制成功只支持该有限人工机制和固定人口，不授予真实响应或跨采集科学晋级。
